extracted.intended_audience: lawyers, practitioners, stakeholders, and member firms who appear before or interact with the USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB)
extracted.subtask_description: Charter for a professional association dedicated to standards, education, advocacy, and member services for attorneys and stakeholders who practice before the PTAB. Defines vision, purpose, member values, and activities the Association will pursue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve and promote highest professional and ethical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Association seeks to preserve and promote the highest professional and ethical standards among lawyers and stakeholders who appear before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated in Vision and Purpose as a core objective; implies activities and policies aimed at ensuring members conduct themselves ethically in PTAB proceedings and interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure just, speedy, and inexpensive resolution of PTAB proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: The Association is dedicated to helping secure the just, speedy, and inexpensive resolution of every PTAB proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated theme: the Association will pursue education, outreach, collaboration and advocacy to help achieve just, expedient, and cost-effective outcomes in PTAB matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain or improve reputation and stature of the PTAB-associated legal profession
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain or improve the reputation and stature of the legal profession and community associated with the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Association activities should contribute to enhancing how the profession and PTAB community are perceived, e.g., through professionalism and constructive engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be economically self-sustaining
rubrics_metrics.description: The Association will be economically self-sustaining.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial sustainability is an explicit organizational standard: programs and operations should be funded so the Association can continue its mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fulfill vision through education, outreach, collaboration, and advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Association will work to fulfill its vision through education, outreach, collaboration, and advocacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates primary methods the Association will employ to meet its goals; guides programmatic choices (e.g., conferences, workshops, recommendations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve as avenue for constructive dialogue among bar, PTAB, and stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: The Association will serve as an avenue for constructive dialogue between the bar community, the PTAB, and other stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the Association as a facilitator of communication and exchange of ideas between practitioners and the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide conferences, workshops, and committees for thoughtful discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide conferences, workshops, and committees through which the PTAB and legal community may engage in thoughtful discussions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit programmatic actions the Association will undertake to promote dialogue, education, and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve integrity, honor, professionalism, and courtesy among members
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserving the highest standards of integrity, honor, professionalism and courtesy among all members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A behavioral expectation for members; suggests promotion of codes of conduct, training, and peer norms to uphold civility and professional ethics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educate members and practitioners in best practices before the PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Educating members and practitioners in best practices before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes dissemination of PTAB-specific procedural and substantive guidance to improve advocacy and case management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster professional and leadership development, mentoring, and advancement
rubrics_metrics.description: Fostering members' professional and leadership development; helping nurture and mentor them as they advance within our profession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages mentoring programs, leadership opportunities, and career development initiatives for members at different career stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide training and continuing education on PTAB developments and best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing training and continuing education on PTAB-specific developments and best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports CLE-style programs, updates about PTAB rule changes or decisions, and practical training for effective PTAB practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide career opportunities for young members (e.g., scholarships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing career opportunities for young members such as through scholarships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific mechanism to support early-career practitioners and increase access to professional development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate good fellowship and collegiality among members
rubrics_metrics.description: Cultivating a spirit of good fellowship and collegiality among all members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote networking, respectful interaction, and community-building activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate pro bono opportunities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize or facilitate public service work to expand access to PTAB-related representation or assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enrich diversity by promoting opportunities for women and minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Enriching the diversity of the PTAB legal community by promoting opportunities for women and minorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls for diversity initiatives, outreach, and programs to increase representation and equitable opportunities in the PTAB community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide unbiased recommendations on proposed PTAB rules and practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing unbiased recommendations on proposed PTAB rules and practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act as an objective advisor to the PTAB by submitting recommendations informed by the bar community's experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propose rules of conduct to ensure practitioners act ethically before the PTAB
rubrics_metrics.description: Helping ensure that practitioners before the PTAB act with the highest ethical standards by, for example, proposing rules of conduct before the PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop or recommend formal conduct standards and promote compliance among practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide constructive feedback and suggestions to improve PTAB trial proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide constructive feedback to the PTAB on how the PTAB may conduct trial proceedings more effectively including suggestions on PTAB rules, trial practice, best practices for practitioners and Administrative Patent Judges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage in advisory and advocacy roles to propose practical reforms or refinements to trial practice and Board procedures to further just, speedy, and inexpensive resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member values (passion, dedication, commitment to diversity/collaboration, professionalism)
rubrics_metrics.description: Member Values: Passionate about supporting the PTAB community; Dedicated to helping the PTAB secure the just, speedy, and inexpensive resolution of every PTAB proceeding; Committed to developing a PTAB community that is diverse and collaborative; Committed to highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Articulates the ethical and cultural baseline expected of members; these values guide conduct, program priorities, and the Association's public posture.
